about: The staged MAP-B island's painted ground (the format-2 painter in js/world.js, through the local preview), as the SHA-256 of the ground canvas's RGBA bytes (terrain: the terrain pass alone, before the features; ground: the finished canvas, terrain and features): 2400 x 1920 world px, 4 bytes each, rows top to bottom. The painter uses integer hashes and + - * / only, so every engine paints the same bytes. tools/mapb-painter.mjs checks it in each engine. Only this canvas is tracked, never a screenshot of the page. Change it only for an approved change to the painter.
